works.body:
Dear Erizo, Thank you very much for finding me!
My name is Yuki Mimei, and I am an individual Vtuber.

I am a personal Vtuber and my name is Mimei Yuki. I love Erizo-sama's glossy and shiny drawings.

I'm a self-proclaimed healthy, safe, and safe-guarding Vtuber who drinks and smokes, and mainly delivers hora-games!
I would like to leave the pose/composition/background to you, but if possible, I would like to have the tattoo on her upper body halfway down her stomach to be visible.

Also, I am very sorry, but since the chest area is almost a wall, please do not depict a sexy body shape, excessive blood, grotesque expressions, or anything that reminds me of medical equipment/medicine, etc.

We would be very grateful if you could also provide us with transparency of the person in the image, as we would like to use it in our YouTube distribution and social networking sites.

We will send you the URL of a solid picture that shows the whole body.
We would be very grateful if you would be willing to produce the image!

https://x.com/Yuki_Mimei/status/1724736565136769309

Hello Erizo, nice to meet you!
My name is Rate Hariyama, a personal VTuber in preparation 🦔.

Thank you for your appeal!
I am very happy that you praised my appearance. I am a hedgehog and I feel very close to Erizo-sama...!

I would love to have you draw my figure!
I will leave the composition, etc. to you. I would appreciate it if you could make sure that there are no gaps in the arms, hair, etc.

Character Details
A hedgehog who loves café lattes and can transform into human form.
She is not a waitress at a cafe.
She is cheerful and calm, and likes to relax and sing songs while drinking café lattes and other drinks.
Her hair is gradated and has a hedgehog's needle-like outward curl, a calm face, and hedgehog ears.

[Usage.
I would like to use it as a VTuber's thumbnail on YouTube, in videos, on distribution, and on various social networking sites.

Requests
I would appreciate it if you could separate the background and characters into separate layers.

Thank you very much. ˬ. ܸ՞)

Height 160 cm, Weight 45 kg

The cat ears and tail are for her own interest.
Reference: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1hFqfXjEST6Ztmoj7V5R6XsIacyRvXrCt?usp=sharing

Thank you for your consideration.

Hello! I hope you are well! Your art is so pretty! I'd be so happy to have you draw my moth girl vtuber! [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ofSXMs_z5v777P79wiZMbICvq0LmV9Mo?usp=sharing] Here is the link! As of right now I only have the concept art and a sketch, I hope these are okay for you to draw! Please include her moth antennae, wings, dragon tail, and dragon horns. I think it would be so unique to have something like https://www.pinterest.com/pin/6966574417329644/ this, but with her eyes open. The dark side to have her eyes and hair glowing, then with the light side to have no glowing at all. 

Thank you for your consideration! Happy drawing!
